limitations: A completed diagnostic is not successful recorder completion or a qualified sampler stack.
Final no-live-group observations establish cleanup at their observation time; they do not retrospectively timestamp every descendant exit at the sampler deadline.
Parent-observed stream clocks are observation bounds, not exact internal tool event times. Native callback deltas use only the helper continuous-clock domain.
A Darwin notification callback does not authenticate its sender or establish a trace epoch.
Trace archive identity and bounded packaging do not establish semantic validity, recording completeness, exported tables, or application-route coverage.
No retained sampler report/stack identifies task acquisition, early symbol discovery, capture, report processing, or authorization as the cause.
The D24 notification-only helper differs from D21; these results do not establish D21 causality.
